info.description:
Zeevou is a Property Management System, Channel Manager, and Direct Booking Website provider. Each host that signs up to Zeevou gets an organisation, within which they can have multiple brands, under which their properties are marketed. From top-down, the system starts with countries, cities, areas, properties, and unit types. Each unit type must hold at least one unit, and can hold more than one. A holiday home would be a property with one unit type and one unit. An apartment block would consist of one property with one or several unit types, each of which may hold one or several units. This structure is mirrored in the website that is produced for each brand.

Unit types also have rate plans associated with them, which detail the price at which a particular unit type can be booked. A booking within a unit type can be locked to a specific unit, however in general it is solely associated with a unit type and the system auto-allocates the unit (users can then manually change the allocation). Each booking has a profile associated for the Person Booking as well as the Lead Guest. Guest profiles for additional guests can also be added to the guest list of a booking. Corporation Profiles sit one level up from guests and are used for business bookers who are part of a company. Invoices can be made out to the Person Booking, the Lead Guest, or the Corporation (depending on what is specified as the Entity Invoiced). Bookings are always part of a Group Booking, which can hold one or several bookings. A booking can have one or multiple invoices, and bookings can have related bookings if a guest books a stay and then extends it subsequently.

Bookings can also have Add-ons applied to them, which may or may not be associated with tasks. Each Task has a task type. Certain task types, such as housekeeping tasks, can be associated with a Housekeeping Report once a task has been completed. Tasks can be assigned to staff members, teams, or companies.

Bookings and add-ons create debits on the profile of the Entity Invoiced, and payments and credit notes create credits on the profile of the Entity Invoiced. Credits are auto-allocated to invoices. Each booking can also have a security deposit that is to be collected before access is provided, which can be handled through Zeevou or can be done manually and logged within Zeevou. Guest profiles need to be manually verified the first time they book a stay with an organisation for access to the property to be granted. Access codes are stored at the unit level and can be overridden at the booking level.

If you have any enquiries, please contact us by emailing openapi@zeevou.com.

To make an authenticated request follow [this link](https://www.oauth.com/oauth2-servers/making-authenticated-requests/).
